recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current core source now preserves the intended relevantHistory semantics without introducing redundant guidance; no further FHIR-20760 core edits are recommended.
issue_request: FHIR-20760 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking the workflow pages to explain how .relevantHistory uses Provenance, including why only relevant Provenance is linked and how relevantHistory is created or updated.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by ade95b75ec, which added Event.relevantHistory to the Event pattern and added Event and Request history guidance. That application substantively covered the requested guidance, and source/fhir.ini plus source/hierarchy.xml show the Event and Request pattern pages are active workflow build pages. The applied prose still contained direct terminology defects: 'Provenence' and references to nonexistent 'recentHistory' where the guidance meant 'relevantHistory'.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms relevantHistory is a curated subset of key Provenance/history events and normally cannot include the current update's Provenance. FHIR-20758 added matching Provenance-page guidance and depended on FHIR-20760; current Provenance notes link to the Event and Request history anchors. FHIR-27794 later refined the Provenance Relevant History profile, which remains present and describes guidance for Event and Request relevantHistory use. Both FHIR-20758 and FHIR-27794 are already represented on the combined branch by separate reconciliation commits.
reconciliation: This reconciliation changed only source/event/event-spreadsheet-notes.xml and source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml, correcting 'Provenence' to 'Provenance' and 'recentHistory' to 'relevantHistory' in the explanatory paragraphs. No additional prose was added because the existing Event, Request, Provenance, and profile guidance already satisfies the substantive request.
source_changes: source/event/event-spreadsheet-notes.xml: corrected the Event history guidance from 'Provenence' to 'Provenance' and from 'recentHistory' to 'relevantHistory'.
source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml: corrected the Request relevantHistory guidance from 'Provenence' to 'Provenance' and from 'recentHistory' to 'relevantHistory'.

related_jiras.note: Security's Provenance-page issue depended on FHIR-20760 and confirms why Provenance guidance needed to link back to Event/Request relevantHistory guidance; it is already represented on the combined branch by 6bf54b945976a13db0f455d3e3102e699434d474.

Later FHIR-I work refined the Provenance Relevant History profile and confirms the profile remains the guidance vehicle for relevantHistory use; it is already represented on the combined branch by 9986fe82ea39f75288ca6d6ab7abeda98a68dc6c.
